name: Administratory
source:
A visual novel in which you have to try on the role of the administrator of a small provincial hotel. There are many different rumors about the hotel. But sooner or later, even secrets turn into a routine…

"Administrators" is if "Clerks" and "Radiance" decided to have a child. A couple of idlers, whiling away monotonous working days in an old hotel, the best days of which are long gone. Secrets? Ghosts? Terrible events of the past? Not interesting. I would like to finish the working day as soon as possible and go home to sleep and play the console.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927270/]Steam[/url]]
